Spoke to Aljazeera about the latest message from Iran’s new supreme leader, message to the GCC and other neighbors, potentials for negotiations, and the future of the war.

Video

US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told Congress that the “unfortunate” strike that hit an Iranian elementary school remains under investigation.

The elementary school in Minab was attacked by the IS on the first hours of the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, killing 170 people, mostly children.

Told @AJEnglish that Iran has been under maximum pressure from the U.S. for years which hurt the people but did not produce policy change. This war will have no absolute winners or losers. Diplomacy requires flexibility and compromise from both sides.

Video

Told Aljazeera that Iran has already been under a silent economic war from the US for many years, which has severely hurt the Iranian people but produced no policy change from the government. So more economic pressure is unlikely to bring surrender.

The way out of this war is a diplomatic resolution which requires concessions from both sides so they can meet somewhere half way.

Video

Told Aljazeera that Iran’s proposal looks reasonable as the situation in the Strait of Hormuz has created a “a global crisis and countries around the world want it resolved”.

“Both Tehran and Washington need to immediately focus on reforming the Strait,” Mortazavi added. “Tehran will not move if the US doesn’t lifts its blockade, and Washington will not do so if Iran does not open the strait. So this can be a good first step towards a more permanent ceasefire, and then after reducing tension, t

Spoke to @AJEnglish about Iran’s latest proposal to the U.S. to end the war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and postpone nuclear talks until later.

Video
In Doha with @Benguennak on Aljazeera, discussing the US-Israeli war on Iran and Lebanon, and the narrow path to peace between Tehran and Washington, via Islamabad, Muscat, and Moscow.

The “Debate Hour” on Aljazeera
Discussing US-Iran peace talks, contradictions in Islamabad, and the future of war. #نقاش_الساعة 
piped.video/JssLpL89XhQ?si=T73Y…

Spoke to @AJEnglish about the staled US-Iran peace talks, last minute changes in Islamabad, the wide gap between the two sides, and the future of the war.

Video

Why did this war start?
What is it exactly?
When will it end? 

Our conversation with @AndrwPMiller, @AbuJamajem, @dylanotes. 

VIDEO: piped.video/1KuqlqeZZkc?si=z8YG…

Video

We had a great discussion on the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran and Lebanon with @AndrwPMiller and @AbuJamajem moderated by my good friend and colleague @dylanotes at CIP.

VIDEO: piped.video/1KuqlqeZZkc?si=W_UJ…

Told @MiddleEastEye that millions of Iranians in Iran have deep political, economic, and social grievances against the government, but they don’t support outside powers launching a war that’s killed thousands of civilians and destroyed Iran’s infrastructure.
piped.video/shorts/w510k8Ixp…

Spoke to Australian radio @abcnews about US-Iran peace talks in Pakistan, ongoing conflict in the Strait of Hormuz, Israel’s attacks on Lebanon, and President Trump threatening to renew bombing Iran.
abc.net.au/listen/programs/r…

Told Australian TV @abcnews that Iran and the U.S. both want to end the war but there’s still a wide gap between the two sides. Trump wants a big victory yet Iran won’t surrender. And Tehran wants to make sure if the war ends it doesn’t come back.

Video

I spoke to @NPR about ceasefire and peace talks between Tehran and Washington, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, and Trump threatening to destroy power plants and bridges, and “blow up the whole country” if Iran doesn’t agree to a deal.

the1a.org/segments/what-the-…

Can Trump & Tehran make peace?  

I spoke to @kaitborsay about war and peace between the U.S. and Iran and the path forward.
open.spotify.com/episode/5gh…
